newsitem.title: USA: TELECOM ARGENTINA TO ADJUST ADS RATIO.
newsitem.headline: TELECOM ARGENTINA TO ADJUST ADS RATIO.

text.p: Telecom Argentina STET-France Telecom SA said Thursday it will adjust its ADS ratio to five shares per ADS from 10 shares as of August 21.
The company said any increase in charges for the deposit or withdrawel of ADSs will not apply until 30 days from the notice.
The company said the exchange ratio for Nortel's 10 percent Manidatorily Exchangeable Debt Securities will be adjusted to reflect the change in ADS ratio.
Nortel Inversora SA, which acquired the majority of the company from the Argentine government, holds 60 percent of Telecom's common stock.
The company reported net income for the quarter of $75 million compared with $64 million.
Earnings per ADS for the quarter was US$0.76.

The company's results for the period included the effects of a recent decree establishing a significant reduction in domestic and international long-distance tarriffs, an increase in basic telephone charges, the elimination of free pulses and an increase in urban rates.
